text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return 1 of your Digimon with the [System], [Life] or [Transmutation] trait to hands or decks.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] Delete 1 of your opponent's play cost 5 or lower Digimon.
